column2: Yāʾayyuhā n-nabiyyu ʾidhā ṭallaqtumu n-nisāʾa faṭalliqūhunna liʿiddatihinna waʾaḥṣū l-ʿiddata wattaqū llāha rabbakum lā tukhrijūhunna min buyūtihinna walā yakhrujna ʾillā ʾan yaʾtīna bifāḥishatin mubayyinatin watilka ḥudūdu llāhi waman yataʿadda ḥudūda llāhi faqad ẓalama nafsahu lā tadri laʿalla llāha yuḥdithu baʿda dhālika ʾamrā

Faʾidhā balaghna ʾajalahunna faʾamsikūhunna bimaʿrūfin ʾaw fāriqūhunna bimaʿrūfin waʾashhidū dhawā ʿadlin minkum waʾaqīmū sh-shahādata lillāhi dhālikum yūʿaẓu bihi man kāna yuʾminu billlahi walyawmi lākhiri waman yattaqi llāha yajʿal lahu makhrajā
Wayarzuqhu min ḥaythu lā yaḥtasibu waman yatawakkal ʿalā llāhi fahuwa ḥasbuhu ʾinna llāha bālighu ʾamrihi qad jaʿala llāhu likulli shāʾin qadrā

Wallā yaʾisna mina l-maḥīḍi min nisāʾikum ʾini rtabtum faʿiddatuhunna thalāthatu ʾashhurin wallā lam yaḥiḍna waʾūlātu l-ʾaḥmāli ʾajaluhunna ʾan yaḍaʿna ḥamlahunna waman yattaqi llāha yajʿal lahu min ʾamrihi yusrā
Dhālika ʾamru llāhi ʾanzalahu ʾilaykum waman yattaqi llāha yukaffir ʿanhu sayyitihi wayuʿẓim lahu ʾajrā

ʾaskinūhunna min ḥaythu sakantum min wujdikum walā tuḍārrūhunna lituḍayyiqū ʿalayhinna waʾin kunna ʾūlāti ḥamlin faʾanfiqū ʿalayhinna ḥattā yaḍaʿna ḥamlahunna faʾin ʾarḍaʿna lakum fātūhunna ʾujūrahunna waʾtamirū baynakum bimaʿrūfin waʾin taʿāsartum fasaturḍiʿu lahu ʾukhrā
Liyunfiq dhū saʿatin min saʿatihi waman qudira ʿalayhi rizquhu falyunfiq mimmā ʾātāhu llāhu lā yukallifu llāhu nafsan ʾillā mā ʾātāhā sayajʿalu llāhu baʿda ʿusrin yusrā
Wakaʾayyin min qaryatin ʿatat ʿan ʾamri rabbihā warusulihi faḥāsabnāhā ḥisāban shadīdan waʿadhdhabnāhā ʿadhāban nukrā
Fadhāqat wabāla ʾamrihā wakāna ʿāqibatu ʾamrihā khusrā
ʾaʿadda llāhu lahum ʿadhāban shadīdan fattaqū llāha yāʾūli l-ʾalbābi ladhīna ʾāmanū qad ʾanzala llāhu ʾilaykum dhikrā

Rasūlan yatlū ʿalaykum ʾāyāti llāhi mubayyinātin liyukhrija ladhīna ʾāmanū waʿamilū ṣ-ṣāliḥāti mina ẓ-ẓulumāti ʾilā n-nūri waman yuʾmin billlahi wayaʿmal ṣāliḥan yudkhilhu jannātin tajri min taḥtihā l-ʾanhāru khālidīna fīhā ʾabadan qad ʾaḥsana llāhu lahu rizqā
Allāhu ladhi khalaqa sabʿa samāwātin wamina l-ʾarḍi mithlahunna yatanazzalu l-ʾamru baynahunna litaʿlamū ʾanna llāha ʿalā kulli shāʾin qadīrun waʾanna llāha qad ʾaḥāṭa bikulli shāʾin ʿilmā
